questions.stem: In a 12-hour period, do the hands coincide between 5 and 6 o'clock?
questions.keySolution: The hands hands may or may not coincide between 5 and 6 o'clock.

questions.stem: Between \(4\) and \(5\) o'clock, at approximately what time will the hands coincide?
questions.keySolution:
The hour and minute hands coincide \(11\) times in \(12\) hours.
They coincide at approximately \(4:21:49\) between \(4\) and \(5\).
Formula: Time of coincidence = \((12/11) × H\) hours.

questions.stem: How many times do the hour hand and minute hand coincide in \(18 hours\)?
questions.keySolution:
In \(18 hours\), the hands coincide approximately \(approximately 16 or 17\) times.
Formula: Number of coincidences = \((11/12) × \text{hours}\)

questions.stem: How many times are the hour and minute hands opposite (at \(180°\)) in \(24 hours\)?
questions.keySolution:
In \(24 hours\), the hands are opposite approximately \(22\) times.
Formula: Opposite occurrences = \((11/12) × \text{hours}\)

questions.stem: What is the exact time (approximately) when the hands coincide between \(8\) and \(9\) o'clock?
questions.keySolution:
The hands coincide at approximately \\(8:43:38\\) between \(8\) and \(9\) o'clock.
Using formula: Time = \((12/11) × H\) hours after 12 o'clock.

questions.stem: How many times do the hands coincide between \(7:00 AM to 1:00 PM\)?
questions.keySolution:
In \(7:00 AM to 1:00 PM\) (6 hours), the hands coincide approximately \(5\) times.
Formula: Coincidences = \(\text{hours} × (11/12)\)

questions.stem: At what exact time do the hour and minute hands coincide at the start of the 12-hour cycle?

questions.stem: In \(24 hours\), do the hands coincide more often or less often than they perpendicular?
questions.keySolution:
In \(24 hours\):
- Hands coincide: \(22\) times
- Hands perpendicular: \(44\) times
Therefore, hands perpendicular more often.

questions.stem: State whether the following is True or False: \(In 24 hours, the hands are perpendicular exactly 22 times.\)
questions.keySolution: The statement is False (44 times).

questions.stem: In \(12 hours\), do the hands perpendicular more often or less often than they opposite?
questions.keySolution:
In \(12 hours\):
- Hands perpendicular: \(22\) times
- Hands opposite: \(11\) times
Therefore, hands perpendicular more often.

questions.stem: State whether the following is True or False: \(The hands are perpendicular twice between each consecutive pair of coincidences.\)
questions.keySolution: The statement is True.
